public_body: Fall River Public Schools Superintendent Of Schools Search Committee
overall: The School Committee violated the OML by failing to respond within ten days to a request for Search Committee minutes; the redaction, procedure, and minutes-detail claims were declined as untimely.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the School Committee (and Search Committee) failed to respond within the 10-day limit to his April and May 2025 requests for Search Committee minutes.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law when it failed to respond to a request for minutes within ten days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Search Committee minutes released in redacted form were improperly redacted.
allegations.key_passage: Because these complaints were filed on May 23, 2025, they are untimely as to any allegation about the redactions.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Search Committee did not follow executive session procedure (reconvening announcement and detriment declaration), so redaction was barred.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation because it is untimely.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Search Committee's executive session minutes lacked sufficient detail, such as interview summaries and lists of documents used.
allegations.key_passage: Because these complaints were filed on May 23, 2025, they are untimely as to this allegation and we decline to review them.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
